fusions.name: Gutter Spring
fusions.desc: Springs up to 6 tiles onto one enemy and bites, dealing 14 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Drainpipe Burst
fusions.desc: A soaked rat bursts up from the drain at one enemy, dealing 32 damage, and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Puddle to Puddle
fusions.desc: Springs you 5 tiles forward, and your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Crouched in the Reeds
fusions.desc: After 6 seconds without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
